title: From PK Data to Document: An AI-Driven Daytrip with Phoenix Cloud
summary: Go from raw PK data to a submission-ready deliverable in a day. See AI-assisted non-compartmental analysis in Phoenix WinNonlin, plus the full Phoenix AI roadmap — with the scientist in control at every step.
body_markdown:
Every week a submission sits unfinished has a price tag. Most sponsors spend eight to twelve weeks moving from database lock to filing, and each extra month before market can cost roughly $60 million in lost NPV. Watch this session on demand to see where that time actually goes, and how Phoenix is closing the gap.


In this recording, we walk through an AI powered path from raw PK data to a deliverable ready for submission, built in a single day. You describe the goal. Phoenix gathers context, proposes a workflow, and builds it. You review, adjust, and sign off. Every output stays visible and traceable, running on the same Phoenix platform regulators already trust.


Watch now to see the Phoenix AI roadmap in action, including an early look at how plain language instructions will soon speed up everyday analysis work without handing over control.


## Why watch:


- Watch AI guided NCA run against a real world dataset
- See the scientist stay in charge, backed by a complete audit trail
- Review results you can actually inspect, not a black box
- Understand exactly where AI helps, and where your judgment still leads
- Preview the Phoenix AI roadmap, available now and coming soon


## This webinar is ideal for


PK analysts, pharmacokineticists, clinical pharmacologists, pharmacometricians, and biometrics or regulatory leaders who own submission timelines.
